content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Migrating & Recreating Records ## slug: migrating-records ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End There are multiple paths to migrating records into Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}}. For existing {{variable.Product_Stripe}} customers, see our documentation on [{{variable.Task_HistoricalSync}}](/v1/docs/historical-sync). To temporarily turn off Stripe callouts and Apex validations, update the applicable [Custom Settings](/v1/docs/custom-settings) under {{variable.CS_BlackthornPayTriggerSetting}}. ## Migrating Records ### Transactions **Source:** CSV Turn off all {{variable.Object_Transaction}}-related Custom Settings (referenced above) or enable {{variable.Field_CS_DisableAllTriggers}} in {{variable.CS_BlackthornPayTriggerSetting}}. :::(Info) () Map your org's Charge Record Type ID value, not the word "Charge". This can be found by navigating to the object's Record Type listing, clicking **Charge**, and pulling the ID from the URL. ::: **Required Fields:** - {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge" - {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} - {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}} - {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Completed" - {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = "Captured" - {{variable.Field_Transaction_NonGateway}} = "True" **Suggested Fields:** - {{variable.Field_Transaction_Account}} - {{variable.Field_Transaction_Contact}} - {{variable.Field_Transaction_ProcessedDat}} (you can map a date field if you don't have date/time available) **Suggested Fields if Records Originated from a Stripe Account:** - {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentGatew}} - {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactioID}} - {{variable.Field_Transaction_CustomerID}} ## Payment Methods **Source:** Raw credit card data :::(Info) () Map your org's Record Type ID value, not the text word. This can be found by navigating to the object's RT listing, clicking **Charge Card** or **ACH**, and pulling the ID from the URL. ::: **Required Fields:** - {{variable.Field_PM_RecordType}} = Charge Card or ACH - {{variable.Field_PM_Email}} **Suggested Fields:** - {{variable.Field_PM_Account}} - {{variable.Field_PM_Contact}} - Address fields 1. Using Data Loader, set your Batch Size to "1". 2. Stripe export with Card IDs & Customer IDs. :::(Info) () Turn off all Payment Method-related Custom Settings (referenced above) or enable `Disable All Triggers` from Blackthorn Pay - Trigger Settings. ::: **Map these Fields:** - {{variable.Field_PM_Last4Digits}} - {{variable.Field_PM_CurrencyISO}} - {{variable.Field_PM_CountryISO}} - {{variable.Field_PM_PaymentMethodStatus}} = "Valid" ## Recreating Records Sometimes, life doesn't give you sunshine. When it happens, records that exist in {{variable.Product_Stripe}} but not in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} must be recreated in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} from the Stripe IDs. Here's an example of recreating a charge so the refund can be conducted within {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. **Step 1: Log into the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} dashboard to see the relevant IDs.** - Gather the following IDs: - Card ID - Customer ID - Transaction ID **Step 2: Create a new {{variable.Object_Transaction}} in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}.** 1. Within Setup > Custom Settings > Blackthorn Pay - Trigger Settings, click {{variable.Button_SF_Manage}} and disable relevant triggers to manipulate records. 2. Fill in the following fields: - {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge" - {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} = Stripe Dashboard Charge amount - {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}} - {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransaStatus}} = "Completed" - {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentStatu}} = "Captured" - Set the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymenMethod}} lookup to the correct {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} that matches the Card ID from Step 1. **Step 3: Click Refund in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}.**
